title: The tensor unit as a canonical monoid object
statement: Let $\mathcal E$ be a monoidal category [def-sfb-monoidal-category], with tensor unit $I$, associator $\alpha$ and left and right unitors $\lambda,\rho$. Then $I$ is a monoid object [det-def-sfb-ring-object-monoid] with unit $1_I:I\to I$ and multiplication $m=\lambda_I:I\otimes I\to I$. In particular, $m\circ(m\otimes1_I)=m\circ(1_I\otimes m)\circ\alpha_{I,I,I}$, $m\circ(1_I\otimes1_I)=\lambda_I$, and $m\circ(1_I\otimes1_I)=\rho_I$. No braiding or additive structure is assumed.
